title: Each owner ruling reaches main soon after it is given, not only when its lane merges
blockedBy: retrospective: owner's earlier words on ruling homes
why: Rulings stored in roadmap/rulings/ on the record branch are invisible to main's guards and to other repos until a lane writes each into a decision record on main (owner 22:03 CST Nov 12: "but i thought roadmaps live on a branch that doesnt reach main? kinda odd?").
source: owner chat with triage 22:03 CST Nov 12
note: Triage offered a small records-only PR per batch of rulings; owner 22:03 CST: "doesnt sound like a bad idea, message retrospective im sure its transcript has my thoughts on this". Asked the retrospective at 22:04 CST for his earlier words on where rulings live; the shape waits on its answer.
